snippet.title: Combat-running Gameplay Demo | Ninja Must Die
snippet.description:
Impressive! they dash on the mountains' tips so fast and hit the enemy quickly, this is a powerful ability unique to ninjas!

Ninja Must die, a ninja, real-time combat, running mobile game, launches in 2022. Pre-registration IS NOW LIVE!! 


Pre-register here:
https://www.pandadagames.com/en
